remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946. .. [notes backing inscription 2]. Somewhat abstract, white birch trees — yellow leaves & foliage. Note: O'Keeffe confirms date." Backing inscriptions date 1925 and 1927. Whitney Archive dates 1927. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1925 and 1927. Downtown Gallery Archive and Abiquiú Notebooks date 1925. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
